phase_cpu: FCFS nonpreemptive shared CPU server: CPU INFER plus an assumed ADMISSION/POST service prefix. Remaining measured wall-time is passive residual, no second full service copy.
phase_sampling: Only observed nonoverlap original phase vectors; whole-vector correlation preserved per request/route.
activity_proxy: Preserve all observed wall phase INFER/ADMISSION/POST features even where assumed CPU service is waiting or has finished; unallocated feature means only observed GAP/RETURN_GAP. These proxies are not CPU utilization. Server traces identify service/queue separately. Additional queue exposure and new pairs remain unvalidated transfer.
